query_analysis.original_query: During commissioning of a gas-liquid separator, we noticed unexpected pressure surges. Could this indicate a safety hazard?
query_analysis.expanded_query: Determine the potential causes of unexpected pressure surges observed during the commissioning of a gas-liquid separator, assess the associated safety risks, and recommend actions to mitigate any identified hazards.

selected_agents.role: Lead assessment of safety hazards associated with pressure surges
Investigate root causes of unexpected pressure surges
Analyze pressure dynamics and recommend control strategies to mitigate surges

communication_strategy.information_flow: Troubleshooter and Dynamics & Control Expert provide findings to Safety Expert, who integrates information to assess safety risks and recommend mitigation actions
communication_strategy.collaboration_protocol: Iterative analysis and collaborative problem-solving to diagnose causes and evaluate safety implications

clarification_questions: Have the pressure surges occurred repeatedly or only under specific operating conditions?
What are the magnitudes and frequencies of the observed pressure surges?
Are there any existing safety systems or alarms responding to these pressure surges?
